decisions.reason: The source decision also retains the sliding-mandrel holes, but that impact is already completely represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY setting sliding_mandrel_holes to remain unchanged.
Retaining the existing bushing and sliding-mandrel holes does not change any current main-shaft stock, diameter, keyway, thread, or bushing-space geometry attribute.
The decision concerns retention of existing holes and does not alter the specified materials or the obligation to show materials on drawings.
Hole retention does not change the fabrication sequence or the established pre-weld and post-weld machining treatment of surfaces 1 and 2.
The source decision does not change the 45-degree angle between the lug hole axes.
The hole decision is a component-design detail already owned by the relevant mechanical Requirements; it does not change the independent obligation to provide a complete manufacturing drawing set.
The decision changes a modeled component detail but does not change the independent requirement to deliver a 3D shaft assembly model.
Retaining the existing holes does not alter the rule for numbering drawings according to the assembly.
